newsitem.title: CANADA: Ranger Oil abandons Angola exploration well.
newsitem.headline: Ranger Oil abandons Angola exploration well.

text.p: Ranger Oil Ltd said on Friday it abandoned its third exploration well offshore Angola after encountering minor oil shows.
Ranger said the rig was moved from the abandoned 4/22-1-1 location to the Kiame oil field 11 km away to begin drill another.
The company said first production from Kiame, where two successful wells were drilled, was expected at the end of 1997 pending upcoming drilling results.
A 670-square-km 3D seismic survey was completed over the western part of Block 4. The block includes recent oil discovery 4/31-1-3 which tested 7,400 barrels of oil per day, the company said.
Further drilling on Block 4 is planned for 1997.
